## Verification

List exact automated and manual checks and their results.

- [ ] Relevant JavaScript files pass node --check.
- [ ] Import, edit, undo/redo, relaunch, and export were exercised where applicable.
- [ ] Missing, malformed, unsupported, or oversized inputs were considered.
- [ ] Filesystem-dialog cancellation leaves state unchanged.
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior were checked for UI changes.
- [ ] The Windows package was built and inspected for release-impacting changes.

## Documentation and distribution

- [ ] User, architecture, privacy, security, and release docs are updated as needed.
- [ ] Data migrations are backward compatible and documented.
- [ ] Dependency licenses and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md are updated as needed.
- [ ] Screenshots use non-sensitive content and contain no private paths or metadata.
- [ ] New assets and preset recipes have documented redistribution permission.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out areas that deserve especially careful review.
